concept.source_prompt: A believable, high-end realistic fantasy stone troll for a premium modern game: moss-green skin with subtle slate mottling, amber eyes, a broad heavy nose, short swept-back horns, small ivory lower tusks, and broad pointed ears. Massive and strong with natural humanlike anatomy, grounded proportions, detailed hands, and a calm, approachable expression. It walks, runs, jumps, climbs, and idles.
concept.design_summary: Realistic fantasy troll with an anatomically grounded heavy build, broad heavy nose and jaw, moss-green skin, slate mottling, amber eyes, swept-back horns, small ivory tusks, and broad pointed ears.
assumptions: The procedural base remains a blockout and does not provide finished troll-specific topology or surface detail.
The CC BY 4.0 Troll mesh is a measurement reference only; its rest pose and design differ from this concept. It is not used as generated geometry.
The requested actions are rig requirements; this profile does not generate animation clips.
